subject: Help  New to Shiny No output from server.R and no errors in R

messages.author: 0a9a8abca1f6484c
messages.subject: Help  New to Shiny No output from server.R and no errors in R
parts:
server.R

library(shiny)
 
# Define server logic required to calculate sample size 
shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  # Compute the formula in a reactive expression
   
     
  formulaText <- reactive({
    if(input$CL=="95%") {value=1.96} else {value=2.58}
    sample$size=value*value*.5*.5/input$Limits
    paste("Sample Size = ", sample$size)

    
  })
    output$caption <- renderText({
       formulaText()
})

   

})

ui.R
library(shiny)

# Define UI for Sample Size application
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

  # Application title
  headerPanel("Sample Size for Proportions"),

  # Sidebar with controls to select the Confidence Level and Limits
  
  sidebarPanel(
    selectInput(inputId="CL",
        label="Choose a Confidence Level",
                choices = c("95%","99%"),
        selected="95%"),

    numericInput("Limits",
        label="Choose a Limit",
                .05),

     submitButton("Update View")
        
  ),

   mainPanel(
   
   
    tableOutput("view")
)
))
